title: Finite components of a geometrically normal projective normalization
statement: Let k be a field and f:T→Spec k projective with dim T≤1 [def-weil-field, def-pc-scheme, def-kun-projective, def-kun-topological-krull-dimension]. Let c_i:C_i→T be integral closed subschemes indexed by Fin n whose distinct supports enumerate exactly the irreducible components [def-pc-integral-scheme, def-weil-irreducible-components]. Assume all stalks of every field base change of the coproduct of C_i-normalizations are integrally closed domains [def-sc-normalization, def-pc-fibre-product, lem-weil-pbc-scheme-coproduct-family, def-weil-pbc-normal-ring]. Then each C_i-normalization is integral and nonempty, projective over k, of dimension at most one, and has integrally closed domain stalks after every field extension. Moreover n=0 if and only if T is empty.

source.place: Tags 0BXR, 0GK4 and 0GK5, decomposition of the projective normalization

proof.text: Reindex the component family by ULift(Fin n) in the universe of schemes. The component supports give a bijection with the irreducible components. Apply the projective component-normalization theorem to the canonical coproduct, and specialize its integral, nonempty, projective and dimension assertions to each lifted index.

For each field extension, base change the original coprojection C_i-normalization→the original Fin n-indexed coproduct. It is an open immersion since coprojections are open and open immersions survive base change. Its stalk maps are isomorphisms. Transfer the assumed domain and integral-closedness properties along these isomorphisms.
The component theorem identifies emptiness of the lifted index set with emptiness of T. ULift(Fin n) is empty exactly when n=0.

theorem projective_geonormal_components
    (k : Type u) [Field k] (T : Scheme.{u}) (f : T ⟶ Spec (.of k)) [IsHProjective f]
    (hdim : topologicalKrullDim T ≤ 1) (n : ℕ) (C : Fin n → Scheme.{u})
    [hC : ∀ i, IsIntegral (C i)] (c : ∀ i, C i ⟶ T)
    [∀ i, IsClosedImmersion (c i)]
    (hi : Function.Injective (fun i ↦ Set.range (c i)))
    (hc : ∀ Z : Set T, Z ∈ irreducibleComponents T ↔ ∃ i, Set.range (c i) = Z)
    (hnormal : ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L],
      ∀ x : ↥(pullback
        (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ (C i).fromNormalization ≫ c i) ≫ f)
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))),
      IsDomain ((pullback
        (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ (C i).fromNormalization ≫ c i) ≫ f)
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).presheaf.stalk x) ∧
      IsIntegrallyClosed ((pullback
        (Sigma.desc (fun i ↦ (C i).fromNormalization ≫ c i) ≫ f)
        (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).presheaf.stalk x)) :
    (∀ i, IsIntegral (C i).normalization ∧ Nonempty (C i).normalization ∧
      IsHProjective ((C i).fromNormalization ≫ c i ≫ f) ∧
      topologicalKrullDim (C i).normalization ≤ 1 ∧
      ∀ (L : Type u) [Field L] [Algebra k L],
        ∀ x : ↥(pullback ((C i).fromNormalization ≫ c i ≫ f)
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))),
        IsDomain ((pullback ((C i).fromNormalization ≫ c i ≫ f)
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).presheaf.stalk x) ∧
        IsIntegrallyClosed ((pullback ((C i).fromNormalization ≫ c i ≫ f)
          (Spec.map (CommRingCat.ofHom (algebraMap k L)))).presheaf.stalk x)) ∧
      (n = 0 ↔ IsEmpty T)
